reviewMethod: Antigravity drafts separately reviewed against complete archived version bodies and source notes; source discrepancies retained explicitly.

headings.title: Election, governor commission, and four-year terms of circuit clerks
headings.reviewNote: Provides for countywide election of circuit clerks every four years beginning 1982, gubernatorial commission, January 1 start, and four-year terms.

headings.title: Court administrators and circuit clerks under county charter governance
headings.reviewNote: Governs selection of court administrator in Jackson County and circuit clerk in St. Louis County under charter.

headings.title: Charter appointment provisions prevailing over statutory elections and state funding
headings.reviewNote: Provides that charter appointment provisions prevail over statutory elections, mandating equivalent state salary reimbursements.

headings.title: Appointment and en banc removal of circuit clerks in sixth and seventh circuits
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes en banc appointment and for-cause removal of circuit clerks in sixth and seventh judicial circuits.

headings.title: Appointment and en banc removal of circuit clerk in twenty-second circuit
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes en banc appointment and for-cause removal of circuit clerk in the City of St. Louis.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all 5 subsections; refined subsection 1 title to match countywide clerk elections, gubernatorial commissions, and charter/en banc selection exceptions.

headings.title: General duties of court clerks to record proceedings and process funds
headings.reviewNote: Requires clerks to record court proceedings, attest process under seal, keep cost accounts, and punctually pay over funds.

headings.title: County commission clerk duties when circuit clerk is party to action
headings.reviewNote: Directs county commission clerk to act as temporary circuit clerk when circuit clerk is a party, excluding expungements.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked both subsections on general clerk recordkeeping/cost duties and county commission clerk replacement when circuit clerk is a party (except expungements).

headings.title: Court clerk recordkeeping duties under supreme court rules
headings.reviewNote: Mandates keeping court records, case dispositions, cost collections, and trial calendars pursuant to supreme court rules.

headings.title: Implementation of modern recordkeeping systems approved by supreme court
headings.reviewNote: Empowers clerks to utilize improved modern recordkeeping techniques and systems as approved by supreme court rule.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked both subsections requiring court clerks to maintain records and modern recordkeeping systems as directed by supreme court rule.

headings.title: Base salary schedule for circuit clerks by county classification
headings.reviewNote: Establishes circuit clerk base salaries across county classifications with increases effective September 1, 2025.

headings.title: Annual salary adjustments under judicial personnel compensation plan
headings.reviewNote: Entitles circuit clerks to annual salary adjustments approved pursuant to section 476.405.

headings.title: Installment payments, state employee status, and charter county funding
headings.reviewNote: Provides for monthly state salary payments and state employee status, with charter county reimbursements.

headings.title: Salaries in lieu of fees and remittance of collected fees
headings.reviewNote: Specifies that clerk compensation is in lieu of fees, requiring all collected fees to be remitted to state or county.

headings.title: Appropriation requirement for salary adjustment effectiveness
headings.reviewNote: Conditions effectiveness of salary adjustments on approval of full funding appropriations by general assembly and governor.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all 5 subsections and Appendix D salary index note covering pre- and post-September 1, 2025 base salaries, section 476.405 adjustments, state employee status, and appropriation condition.

headings.title: Clerk duty to maintain report catalogue and deliver to successor
headings.reviewNote: Requires court clerks to maintain an official catalogue of state reports and deliver all reports to successors.

headings.title: Treble damage liability on clerk bond for failure to deliver reports
headings.reviewNote: Directs legal action on clerk bond for treble the value of reports not delivered to successor.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked both subsections requiring clerks to catalogue and deliver reports to successors with treble-value bond liability for failure.

headings.title: Circuit clerk cooperation in criminal nonsupport investigations
headings.reviewNote: Requires circuit clerks outside St. Louis City to cooperate with prosecutors and family support division on nonsupport cases.

headings.title: Additional annual compensation of five thousand dollars for nonsupport duties
headings.reviewNote: Provides five thousand dollars additional annual compensation to circuit clerks for nonsupport investigation duties.

headings.title: Annual salary adjustments for criminal nonsupport compensation
headings.reviewNote: Applies section 476.405 salary adjustments annually to nonsupport duty compensation beginning July 1, 1998.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all 3 subsections on circuit clerk criminal nonsupport cooperation outside St. Louis City, $5,000 annual pay, and section 476.405 adjustments.

headings.title: Notice and suspension of court clerk charged with misdemeanor in office
headings.reviewNote: Directs court notice to attorney general or prosecutor and authorizes suspension of clerks charged with official misdemeanors.

headings.title: Appointment, oath, bond, and powers of temporary court clerk
headings.reviewNote: Requires court to appoint a qualified temporary clerk with oath, bond, and full powers pending suspension.

headings.title: Clerk bond to remain in office pending trial on charges
headings.reviewNote: Allows charged clerk to remain in office by posting surety bond within fifteen days to pay potential costs, fines, and damages.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all 3 subsections on misdemeanor-in-office charges, mandatory temporary clerk appointment during suspension, and 15-day surety bond to remain in office.

headings.title: Circuit clerk administrative control over circuit court records and exceptions
headings.reviewNote: Grants circuit clerks administrative control over court records, excepting probate, associate, municipal, and violations bureaus.

headings.title: Judicial control over division clerks and safekeeping of division records
headings.reviewNote: Vests administrative control of division clerks and records in appointing associate circuit and probate judges.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked both subsections delineating circuit clerk control over circuit court records, division exceptions, and judge control over division clerks.

headings.title: Deputy circuit clerks as clerical staff under circuit clerk control
headings.reviewNote: Designates deputy circuit clerks as clerical staff performing duties under general administrative control of circuit clerk.

headings.title: Division clerks as clerical staff under appointing judge control
headings.reviewNote: Designates division clerks as clerical staff performing division recordkeeping under administrative control of appointing judge.

headings.title: Municipal clerks as clerical staff for municipal division records
headings.reviewNote: Designates municipal clerks as circuit court clerical staff responsible for municipal division recordkeeping.

headings.title: Clerical staffing responsibilities for traffic violation bureaus
headings.reviewNote: Specifies clerical staffing for traffic violation bureaus by municipal clerks or municipal personnel depending on judges.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all 4 subsections assigning clerical duties to deputy circuit clerks, division clerks, municipal clerks, and traffic violation bureau staff.

headings.title: Effective date of deputy and division clerk appointment provisions
headings.reviewNote: Establishes July 1, 1981, effective date for deputy circuit clerk and division clerk statutory provisions.

headings.title: Appointment and removal authority for deputy circuit clerks and division clerks
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes circuit clerks to appoint and remove deputies, and division judges to appoint and remove division clerks.

headings.title: Preservation of local charter merit selection and retention plans
headings.reviewNote: Preserves existing charter merit selection and tenure systems for clerical personnel transitioning to state employment.

headings.title: Circuit court en banc authority to remove clerical personnel for cause
headings.reviewNote: Empowers circuit court en banc to remove any deputy circuit clerk or division clerk from office for cause.

headings.title: Court en banc and supreme court determination of maximum clerical staffing
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes circuit court en banc to set maximum staffing numbers, subject to modification by supreme court.

headings.title: Salary ranges, supreme court classification rules, and state employee status
headings.reviewNote: Establishes clerk salaries within supreme court administrative classifications, payable by state as state employees.

headings.title: Clerical staffing and salary limits subject to legislative appropriations
headings.reviewNote: Provides that staffing numbers and salary determinations do not mandate appropriations and depend on available funding.

headings.title: Definition and voting rules for circuit court en banc actions
headings.reviewNote: Defines circuit court en banc to include all circuit and associate judges, requiring majority vote for determinations.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all 8 subsections on July 1, 1981 effective date, deputy/division clerk appointment and removal, charter merit plans, staffing caps, state pay, and en banc voting.

headings.title: Investment of court registry deposits in authorized interest accounts
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes court orders directing clerks to invest registry funds in insured banks, thrifts, or US treasury bills.

headings.title: Clerk investment after sixty days and permitted uses of income
headings.reviewNote: Permits clerk to invest registry funds absent party application within 60 days, apply income to specified office/publication/court expenses, and pay any balance to county general revenue.

headings.title: Definition of clerk for court registry investment sections
headings.reviewNote: Defines "clerk" for sections 483.310 and 483.312 to include circuit clerks and clerks designated under section 483.550 for cases where they collect court costs.

headings.title: Collection procedures for court-ordered non-cost moneys
headings.reviewNote: Permits clerks charged by a court with collecting non-cost moneys to use sections 488.010 to 488.020 collection procedures if unpaid.

headings.title: Permitted depository institutions and constitutional investment limits
headings.reviewNote: Permits clerks to deposit funds in depository institutions and restricts investments to those permitted the state treasurer under Mo. Const. Art. IV, § 15.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all 5 subsections and Grinnell Mutual (194 S.W.3d 830) annotation; replaced fabricated/mismatched headings on subsections 2–5 to match 60-day clerk investment, clerk definition, non-cost collection, and Mo. Const. Art. IV § 15 limits.

headings.title: Security requirements for bank deposits exceeding federal insurance limits
headings.reviewNote: Requires depositary banks holding registry funds over federal insurance limits to pledge securities meeting state standards.

headings.title: Constant value of pledged securities and delivery to clerk or trustee
headings.reviewNote: Mandates constant security value equal to excess deposits and authorizes delivery to clerk or disinterested trustee.

headings.title: Depositary contract breach, written demand, and surrender of securities
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes clerk written demand upon contract breach for immediate surrender of pledged securities by trustee.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all 3 subsections governing pledged security for registry deposits over federal insurance limits, constant value, and trustee surrender on breach.

headings.title: Recording of pleadings, service returns, and notices in civil actions
headings.reviewNote: Permits parties upon fee payment to have pleadings, returns, commissioner notices, and sale proofs recorded by clerk.

headings.title: Recording fee of ten cents per hundred words payable to county treasury
headings.reviewNote: Sets recording fee of ten cents per hundred words, payable into the county treasury.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked both subsections permitting recording of civil action papers in circuit clerk office at ten cents per hundred words payable to county treasury.

headings.title: Oath of office required for probate clerks upon appointment
headings.reviewNote: Requires every appointed probate clerk to take the constitutional oath prescribed for clerks of courts of record.

headings.title: Itemized fee account statements provided to payors upon request
headings.reviewNote: Requires probate clerks to provide itemized statements of charges citing authorizing statutory sections upon request.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked both subsections and section 472.070 cross-reference on probate clerk oath and itemized statutory fee accounts upon request.

headings.title: Appellate court costs payable by appellant and public fee waivers
headings.reviewNote: Requires appellants to pay statutory court costs on appeal, exempting proceedings where fees are waived or paid by public.

headings.title: Collection, disbursement, and general revenue deposit of appellate fees
headings.reviewNote: Directs initial filing clerk to collect costs and remit them to director of revenue for deposit into general revenue.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked both subsections on appellate court costs, public/waived exemptions, initial-court clerk collection, and general revenue deposit.

headings.title: Circuit clerk collection and disbursement of court costs and exceptions
headings.reviewNote: Charges circuit clerks with collecting court costs, excluding associate divisions, probate, municipal, and traffic bureaus.

headings.title: Probate division chief clerk collection of probate court costs
headings.reviewNote: Directs each chief division clerk for the probate division of the circuit court to charge and collect all accruing probate court costs.

headings.title: Division clerk designation for associate circuit court cost collection
headings.reviewNote: Directs associate circuit judges (or local rule/majority under centralized filing) to designate by order of record a division clerk responsible for collecting court costs.

headings.title: Local circuit court en banc rule adopting centralized cost collection system
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes circuit court en banc to centralize all court cost collection under circuit clerk by local rule.

headings.title: Periodic reports of delinquent court costs to state courts administrator
headings.reviewNote: Requires responsible clerks to file periodic delinquent cost reports as directed by state courts administrator.

headings.title: Prosecutor and attorney general enforcement of delinquent court costs
headings.reviewNote: Directs prosecutors and attorney general to reasonably attempt collection of delinquent court costs.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all 6 subsections; fixed subsection 2 to cover probate chief division clerks only and broadened subsection 3 to cover both single-division and centralized associate circuit cost collection.

headings.title: Court costs charged and collected in probate proceedings
headings.reviewNote: Requires charging and collecting probate court costs from estates or parties under sections 488.010 to 488.020 (*original rolls cite section 514.015).

headings.title: Probate division clerk responsibility for charging and collecting costs
headings.reviewNote: Charges clerk of the probate division with collecting probate court costs, subject to centralized collection rules.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked both subsections and original-rolls footnote (*section 514.015 changed to 488.010–488.020) on probate proceeding court costs.

headings.title: Transfer of municipal court records to circuit court on January 2, 1979
headings.reviewNote: Transfers 1979 municipal court records to circuit courts, with physical custody rules depending on municipal judges.

headings.title: Retention of un-transferred pre-1979 records as municipal property after 1982
headings.reviewNote: Provides that un-transferred pre-1979 records cease being circuit records after January 1, 1982, reverting to municipalities.

headings.title: Clerk authority to issue certified copies of municipal court records
headings.reviewNote: Empowers clerks having custody of municipal records to issue certified copies recognized by all courts.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all 3 subsections governing January 2, 1979 transfer of municipal court records to circuit courts, post-1982 municipal retention, and certified copies.
